title: Security

authentication.heading: Authentication
authentication.body: Your account is secured with one-time password authentication. There's no password to change — every sign-in is verified by email code.

signOutEverywhere.heading: Sign out everywhere
signOutEverywhere.body: Revokes every active session for your account, on every browser and device. You'll be signed out of this session too and will need to sign in again.
signOutEverywhere.confirmPrompt: This will sign you out of this browser too. Continue?

flash: All sessions signed out — please sign in again.
